title: At Startup Grind, Eric Ries: 'change the world for the better'
summary: Shinde is a founder who wrote up Startup Grind with a verdict in two halves: the sessions that worked talked to the room, and the fireside format left the audience outside it. Eric's session heads the first list, for something he said he had omitted from The Lean Startup, with Incorruptible named as what comes next.
blockquote: -> Eric Ries shared something he left out of The Lean Startup: "change the world for the better." A decade later, he's coming out with his new book - "Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad... and How Great Companies Stay Great." Can't wait!
